pages.text: Health 170, Armor 3, Knockback Resistance 0.5, Attack 6, Speed 0.2.$(br)Lord of the tomb and mighty ruler of the Old Second Round civilisation, of dreadful martial might - and a noble of a line that once held these lands,.
so even in death his guards are still ranked about him... Little wit is left in him now, but a little work sees this undead tyrant see the sense in following you, and he fights for you.

You may call on this lord through the $(l:supreme/items/ornate_sediment_lord_coffin)Coffin of the Ornate Sediment Lord$(), and should he fall his totem brings him back quickly. You can also give him a $(item)Nether Star$(), a $(item)Drowned Necromancer's Soul Jar$(), a $(item)Heavy Armored Sediment Guard Focus$(), a $(item)Sediment Soul Stabilizer Focus$() or $(item)Berserk E

The token that flies back to its owner's hand when the Sediment Lord falls, with the lord sealed inside. Right-click the $(l:supreme/items/ornate_sediment_lord_coffin)Coffin of the Ornate Sediment Lord$() with it and the lord sealed within rises on the spot.$(br)With nothing sealed inside, right-clicking the coffin only earns a "there is no lord sealed in this totem".
5, Attack 6, Speed 0.2.$(br)You can right-click your Sediment Lord with $(item)Rotten Flesh$() to heal it.
